::: spotlight-text
**I am a postdoctoral scholar at The Ohio State University** & a member of both the [Affective Science Lab](https://affectivesciencelab.com/) & the [Social Neuroscience and Health Lab](https://carolinasnhlab.com/). I study how people sense and make sense of their bodies with implications for human health & social functioning across the lifespan.

[Learn more about me →](about.qmd){.btn .btn-secondary}
